### Forest {#review-app-1}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      15 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _app reviewer aak_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "Used it for a month and generally had a decent experience with their bikes. However, the app is very buggy, and can sometimes not end your ride properly resulting in an overcharge. I have tried contacting support multiple and they haven’t got back to me, nor have they even acknowledged receipt of my issue. I think they just hope you dont notice these charges and over time, give them more money that you dont owe them. Cancelled my subscription to them and switched back to Lime."
            2. _HL46645_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "This is an objectively terrible app. It has constant issues that cannot be put into a review. It constantly lets you down and is significantly worse than competitors. This wouldn’t be an issue if it didn’t resort to buying monopolies in areas to force people into paying for its horrible service who have no other choice. It will constantly let you down and make you pay for the privilege. Awful"
            3. _Samuel5757_, Aug 5, 2026, 4/5: "I’ve had a frustrating few weeks with Forest. I bought several minute bundles that I either couldn’t use properly because the app wouldn’t let me start or end rides during the recent technical issues, and it took much longer than I’d have liked to get everything resolved. That said, I do want to give credit where it’s due. I eventually managed to get through on the live chat, and the issue was resolved. It’s a shame I had to go the extra mile to get there, as it did leave me feeling ignored for a while, but the support I received in the end was genuinely helpful. The recent technical issues have clearly been significant, and I appreciate that it’s not easy for a smaller, home-grown business to deal with problems on that scale. Communication could certainly be improved during outages, but I’m hopeful this has been a learning experience. For now, my faith in Forest has been restored. I really like the service when it’s working well, and I’m looking forward to seeing the reliability and customer support continue to improve. Keep it up!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

### Notion: notes, tasks, AI {#review-app-5}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Aug 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _narwhalez123_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used! You can’t do anything without the screen freezing and it feels like it’s just turned into a generic ai chatbot app with a little bit of organisation on the side (that doesn’t even work most of the time??) it’s so disappointing to see and I hope the creators import an ai-free version for notetakers who actually think for themselves, perhaps the lack of ai will make some of the other features less laggy."
            2. _Clashofvlansbrah_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "This app refreshes every 5 seconds while you’re trying to type. Notion for desktop is great. This IOS platform is, and has been broken for a long time."
            3. _alitur43_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I tried this app a couple of years ago as I loved it on my laptop, and I decided to try it again because I assumed that by now they should have fixed the iPad/iPhone functionality up a bit. I was wrong. I actually don't understand how you can have such an appalling usability as an app but be so good on the web, and continue to stay unusable as an app for years at a time despite all the reviews telling you how bad your app is. I can't access templates (FREE templates) on my iPad, it takes me 30 seconds to open old notes, the dashboard and sidebar glitch around once a minute, I struggle to load things up, it drains my battery stupidly quickly and don't even get me STARTED on trying to type things/use the keyboard. Seriously, why is it so hard to do literally anything on the app? The degree to which things STILL don't work after 2 years is surreal to me."
<!--/ir-theme-->

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->

         **Review examples:**

            3. _Alea-pea_, Jun 23, 2026, 3/5: "I really love this app and it has helped me immensely when it comes to getting organised– although it’s an ongoing process and I’m still learning! I look forward to any improvements and to upgrading my rating to five stars. Many thanks for the app!"
